decisions.reason: Using a simpler model approach does not change the required Excel format or the prohibition on substituting the error-prone PDF.
The simpler approach supports usability but does not alter the existing requirement for a professional, clear, strongly presented government-submission model.
The source does not revise the DSCR and equity-IRR targets or authorize replacing the confirmed availability-payment sizing method.
The request for a simpler approach does not change the confirmed operating-cost basis, full-network scope, or assumption-disclosure policy.
The source does not change the twelve-site structure, authoritative site list, typologies, or treatment of missing site-level details.
Although the financing structure is streamlined, the source does not modify its confirmed 55/45 split, approximate rate, tranche structure, or provisional status.
A simpler model approach does not resolve or change the AUD currency basis, 2031 price base, or existing currency ambiguity.
The source does not authorize combining, omitting, or otherwise changing the required separate program-wide capex line items.
The simpler approach does not remove or revise the required equity-IRR output or its confirmed target range.
The generic simplification decision does not authorize changing or removing the specifically confirmed asset-appropriate CCA and depreciation treatment.
The simpler approach does not change the required reference basis, provisional-input policy, or disclosure of assumptions; those traceability requirements remain valid unchanged.
Simplifying the model does not change the required conclusion or evidence standard for demonstrating the necessity of availability-style payments.
